content: 1) Building on lessons learned from prior work, we create a more comprehensive lexical semantic similarity dataset for the English language spanning a total of 1,888 concept pairs balanced with respect to similarity, frequency, and concreteness, and covering four word classes: nouns, verbs, adjectives and, for the first time, adverbs. This dataset serves as the main source for the creation of equivalent datasets in several other languages.
